description: This Java class implements a DTLS certificate verifier for CoAP protocol in the Thingsboard platform. It handles certificate validation, session management, and device credential verification via external services.

classes.name: TbCoapDtlsCertificateVerifier
classes.description: Implements DTLS certificate verification for CoAP in Thingsboard, managing session storage and device credential validation.

methods.name: getSupportedCertificateTypes
methods.description: Returns supported certificate types, specifically X.509.

methods.name: verifyCertificate
methods.description: Validates the certificate chain, checks validity, and verifies device credentials via external transport service.

methods.name: getAcceptedIssuers
methods.description: Returns list of accepted issuer principals for certificate validation.

methods.name: setResultHandler
methods.description: Sets the handshake result handler (no implementation).

methods.name: getTbCoapDtlsSessionsMap
methods.description: Returns the current DTLS sessions map.

methods.name: getDtlsSessionReportTimeout
methods.description: Returns the session report timeout value.
